protocol.selection: The ViT localization coefficient -50 was selected on the original multi-value 50-image validation search at tau=.4, epsilon=.1, variance=5; test results are held out.
protocol.noise: 50 image-keyed uniform[-0.2,0.2] perturbations in normalized input coordinates.
protocol.bootstrap: 10,000 paired image resamples, seed 42, unadjusted percentile 95% intervals.
